editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out you have gills on your body. That is exactly what happens to Gon, a boy who was almost dead until these strange growths saved his life. You will follow Gon as he is taken in by a kind grandpa and a boy named Kang-ha. At first, it feels like a weird little family setup, but there is a lot of tension. Kang-ha is tough on Gon, almost like he is trying to keep him hidden or controlled because the world would not understand someone like Gon. It is a sweet and sad story about finding where you belong when you are completely different from everyone else.

What really makes this movie work is the beautiful animation and the emotional bond between the kids. The pacing starts a bit slow, but it builds up to a powerful finish that will definitely make you tear up. If you love stories about found families, you need to see this. Since the visuals are so stunning, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call because the colors are just that good.
endingExplained: In the end, Kang-ha realizes that keeping Gon hidden is actually hurting him. To save him from a life of fear, he pushes Gon to leave their safe bubble and enter the wide world. Gon finally embraces his identity and travels far, just like the legendary bird he was named after. He finds peace and freedom in the ocean, proving that being different is actually his greatest strength and his way to survive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartwarming stories about friendship and overcoming odds.
